findings.title: Concurrent MCP token issuance can exceed the active-token cap
whySourceOnlyIsInsufficient: The route count and insert are separate PostgREST operations.
A process mutex cannot serialize multiple serverless instances.
A route-only distributed lease would not protect the operator CLI direct insert path.
Mock tests cannot prove a database-wide active-token invariant.

minimumCorrectDesign.databasePrimitive: A per-site row-lock trigger or atomic transactional function protecting insert and activation updates.
minimumCorrectDesign.lockTarget: The sites row for the token site_id, selected FOR UPDATE.
minimumCorrectDesign.activePredicate: site_id match, disabled=false, created_at within the configured token lifetime, and created_at not in the future.
minimumCorrectDesign.failureContract: Reject at the cap with a stable database error mapped to HTTP 409 without returning plaintextToken.
minimumCorrectDesign.coverage: The database guard must protect API, CLI, and any future service-role insert path.

requiredVerification: Concurrent inserts at cap-1 allow exactly one success and finish at the cap.
Concurrent disabled-to-active updates cannot exceed the cap.
Disabled, expired, and future-dated rows follow the declared active predicate.
Different sites do not share one lock.
API and CLI never disclose plaintext on rejection.

findings.title: Worker site-transfer protection has a check-then-upsert race
whySourceOnlyIsInsufficient: The route lookup and upsert are separate operations.
Two first writes can both observe no row and then overwrite site_id through the conflict update.
A multi-statement source workaround can partially persist a mixed worker batch before a later conflict.
A process mutex cannot serialize multiple serverless instances.

minimumCorrectDesign.databasePrimitive: A service-role-only transactional RPC for the complete worker batch.
minimumCorrectDesign.conflictContract: ON CONFLICT (organization_id, external_key) may update profile fields only when the stored site_id equals the requested site_id; site_id is never updated by conflict handling.
minimumCorrectDesign.atomicFailure: Any mismatched or null existing site binding raises a stable error and rolls back the complete batch.
minimumCorrectDesign.tenantCheck: The RPC verifies that site_id belongs to organization_id.
minimumCorrectDesign.privilege: EXECUTE remains unavailable to public, anon, and authenticated roles.

requiredVerification: Concurrent writes for different sites allow exactly one binding.
A mixed batch with one site conflict leaves no partial inserts or updates.
Same-site concurrent profile updates remain supported.
Null existing bindings, duplicate external keys, and organization/site mismatches fail closed.
The route preserves the existing workerMap success contract and maps only the stable site-conflict error to HTTP 409.

scope: Author and apply one or more Supabase migrations for the transactional controls.
Create trigger/function/RPC objects and least-privilege execution grants.
Run PostgreSQL or Supabase concurrency integration tests with temporary rows.
Update API and CLI paths to consume stable database errors or RPC results.
